support_qualification.proof_from_original_code: energy_grid appends linspace(CUT,SPLIT,low_cells+1)[1:] and geomspace(SPLIT,UPPER,high_cells+1)[1:], so10eV is an exact low-grid endpoint. source_vectors classifies high when interval lo>=10; project distributes only to adjacent lower/upper grid nodes. For every high-born quadrature point W>10, both bounding nodes are>=10. First high interval has lower=10; no high source mass is projected below10.
support_qualification.low_cross_semantics: Mask E<=10 records the high-born mass projected onto the10eV boundary. It is a diagnostic duplicate, not evidence of an additional below10 source.
support_qualification.if_changed_projection_crosses_partition: Bind separate native_birth_support for event ownership and projected_measure_support for atoms, with an exact projection/source identity and qualification; do not silently expand native source support. Not needed for this pinned input.
